---
title: "DataExplorer"
---

```{r}
library(DataExplorer)
library(tidyverse)

library(wehoop)

wnba_pbp <- wehoop::load_wnba_pbp()
wnba_team_box <- wehoop::load_wnba_team_box()
wnba_player_box <- wehoop::load_wnba_player_box()
```

```{r}
data_list <- list(wnba_pbp, wnba_player_box, wnba_team_box)
plot_str(data_list)
```

```{r}
introduce(wnba_pbp)

plot_intro(wnba_pbp)

plot_missing(wnba_pbp)
```

```{r}
plot_histogram(wnba_player_box)
```

```{r}
plot_qq(wnba_team_box)
```

```{r}
plot_boxplot(wnba_team_box, by = "team_winner")
```
